title: Confidence Calibration of LLM-Based Safety Monitors

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Calibration is a prerequisite for operating at a specific precision-recall point. Without it, even a capable monitor cannot reliably hit its target operating point. Foundational measurement for deployment teams.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Running three LLM judges on a labeled dataset and computing calibration curves is straightforward. Uses API calls, standard statistical methods (Platt scaling). Well within beginner capability with medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three monitors, one dataset, calibration curves. Clear deliverable (calibration comparison across monitors). Well-scoped for 30 hours. Each monitor evaluation is independent and parallelizable.
